taf.remove.not_finished: Not finished: its {steps} couldn't be removed. tafs tries again each time it refreshes.
taf.remove.not_finished_after: {cards} Not finished: its {failed} couldn't be removed. tafs tries again each time it refreshes.
taf.remove_body: Its Cards are revoked, its schedule stopped, its chats, run reports, memory and key deleted, and its name freed. KIFF's receipts stay.
taf.report.when_run_ends: Its report shows here when the run ends.
taf.revoke_body: No new action goes through. Anything already done stays done.

version.cant_any_more: Your taf can't do this any more.

version.card_note.removes: While it switches, your taf doesn't run. Confirming once issues these Cards in KIFF and removes the ones this version doesn't have, then this version goes live.
version.card_note.removes_biometry: While it switches, your taf doesn't run. Confirming with {biometry} once issues these Cards in KIFF and removes the ones this version doesn't have, then this version goes live.
version.card_out_of_date: Version {n|possessive} Card is out of date: a Card changed since it was drafted. Draft it again, then read it before you approve.
version.card_unreadable: This version's Card couldn't be read.

version.doesnt_run_until: Your taf doesn't run until it's installed or you cancel.

version.install_unfinished: Installing version {n} didn't finish. {why} Your taf doesn't run until you finish or cancel it.
version.intro: Installing a version makes it the live version, forward or back. One confirmation covers it.
version.not_a_trial.confirmed: KIFF didn't start a trial: it issued these Cards as the taf's own. Check its Card tab, or install the version you had.
version.not_a_trial.other: KIFF didn't start a trial for this version (it answered {status}). Nothing runs under it.
version.out_of_date_card: What you're asked to approve changed since it was shown. Read it again, then approve.

version.while_you_try.live_keeps_working: The live version keeps working: its schedule, Card and budget don't change.

voice.dictation_stopped_tap_mic_start: Dictation stopped: {why} Tap the mic to start again.

voice.puts_message_box_back: Puts the message box back as it was.
voice.speech_recognition_not_available_l: Speech recognition isn't available for this language.

voice.speech_recognition_restricted_devi: Speech recognition is restricted on this device, so dictation can't run.
voice.stopped: Dictation stopped. Tap the mic to start again.
voice.tafs_turns_your_voice_into: tafs turns your voice into text on this device. Your voice isn't sent anywhere.

voice.voice_becomes_text_device_not: Your voice becomes text on this device. It isn't sent until you send it.
voice.what_you_said_stays_message: What you said stays in the message box, unsent.
